description: Data tuning for first-batch Miracle/Oracle effects; no forced production quotas, no direct conversion, separate Mastery/cooldown.
eligibilityNote: Current single-God PoC only approximates destructive local strength by weighted own-faith Presence. Full rival-Dominance assessment is deferred to multi-God.
cooldownPolicy: Cooldown is a per-Miracle DP escalation, not a hard casting lock. Cast #1 costs normal base DP; while that same skill is cooling, cast #2 costs 2x its current base DP, #3 3x, and so on. The next cast starts or extends (never shortens) that skill's existing cooldown deadline. When cooldown fully expires its chain resets to 1x. Other skills and the other God have independent cooldown chains. DP insufficiency still prevents casting; all actual targets/capability/cooldown-duration checks remain.
cooldownDPPolicy: Fixed incremental 1x base DP for each additional cast within the same active cooldown. This first playable prototype intentionally has no second overcharge currency, no arbitrary maximum number of casts, and no global shared cooldown penalty.
